title: Q-FLEETMAP-seed: ultrastable/seed is not equal to its source (40 file(s) differ, 5 missing, 0 only in the copy)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** fleetmap --drift --apply (daily in tenant-sync.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed
**Prediction:** fleet_map_drifted_repos <= 0 within 168 h
**Status:** closed

ultrastable/seed is a copy and is not equal to its source (FLEET-MAP-1): 40 file(s) differ, 5 missing, 0 only in the copy.

- differ: SECURITY.md, worker/src/appaudit.js, worker/src/auth/connectors.js, worker/src/auth/index.js, worker/src/auth/social.js, worker/src/auth/store.js, worker/src/criticality.js, worker/src/doer.js, worker/src/executor.js, worker/src/freshness.js, worker/src/goals.js, worker/src/graphai.js ...
- missing: worker/src/holds.js, worker/test/spec-13-service-levels.test.js, worker/test/spec-14-kit-health.test.js, worker/test/spec-14-second-producer.test.js, worker/test/spec-25-control-plane.test.js

Fix the sync named in doctrine/fleet-map.json for this repository (never copy by hand), then the same reading closes this item.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-27T14:53:24Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 39.5 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
